rationale: Engine sets has_zero_optimizer_state = zero or bf16, so bf16 without ZeRO is wrongly flagged as having ZeRO state. Detected at build by asserting has_zero_optimizer_state == (zero_stage>0); a free-form module attribute, hence Tier 6. Borderline P8 vs P4: chose P8 because the wrong flag is set once in __init__ and never changes, single-GPU reproduces so parallel_dim=none.
